_doc: Paths whose change in FROM..TO decides the gates, the hook wiring, the deploy or the restart.
fork-deploy.mjs prints them on the never-cut 'Kapu/deploy utak' line of the owner text (plan v3 addendum A1-3).
This file lives under scripts/deploy/, a protected path, so adding or removing a pattern is a reviewed change (Ron 17165, suggestion).
Pattern forms: 'dir/**' = everything under dir; '*' = any characters inside one path segment; anything else = exact path.
package.json counts only when its 'scripts' key changed (packageJsonScripts); package-lock.json is the package list, not a gate path.
